evidence: Protocol emissions are rerouted into bribes on a malicious CL gauge. With minimal votes directed to the fake gauge, HYBR meant for LPs or stakers is swept during fee claims and redirected to the bribe contract that pays whoever votes for that gauge. This drains rewards from honest participants, distorts governance incentives, and can be scaled by concentrating votes. The path requires no privileged roles. It relies only on permissionless CL gauge creation that lacks a factory authenticity check and on the balance sweep in the CL fee claim.
